note: This release now vendors P4_CONTRACT_v2.1.2 (shared/contracts/P4_CONTRACT_v2.1.2/, all 11 files sha256-verified locally). This snapshot records conformance/gaps against the canonical contract, not a competing proposal.

conformance.queryRegistrySchema: query_registry.yaml in this release follows the contract's primaryKey (operationName+sha256Hash) and columns (variablesSchemaJson/responseSchemaJson in place of the earlier informal responseSchemaVersion field).
conformance.coverageSchema: monthly_coverage.csv carries coverageStatus/coverageReason/platformCoverageRegime per contract. 2019 rows use the contract's exact provisional values (insufficient/platformPreLaunch/preStableRecruitService).
conformance.keyContract: Not yet applied by Agent 1 -- postingId/rawPostingId/trackId etc. generation is Agent 2's pipeline responsibility. Recorded here for reference: PST_/RAW_/TRK_/SEC_/REQ_/NMT_ prefixes, SHA-256, '|' separator, 20 hex chars.
conformance.sourcePolicyGate: IMPORTANT UPDATE FOR AGENT 3 -- SOURCE_POLICY_GATE.md condition 3/5 (transparentClientVerified=true, clientAccessMode not impersonatedOnly) were evaluated against RECON_20260806_01 evidence (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome only). CRAWL_20260806_01 (commit bec745b, prior to this release) already established httpx-with-honest-UA reproduces identical 200 responses with NO impersonation for both APQ list and SSR detail. This should allow qa.vSourcePolicyGate to move from REVIEW_REQUIRED toward PASS -- filed as AGENT1_TO_AGENT3_ISSUES A1-A3-012.

requiredCollectorRulesStatus.Omit the status filter from historical c: IMPLEMENTED -- all pagination-audit and detail collection in this release omits status from filterBy.
requiredCollectorRulesStatus.Advance global nodePagination until ever: IMPLEMENTED and empirically verified complete on 11/79 target months (monthly_coverage.csv).
requiredCollectorRulesStatus.Scan activityTextHtml for embedded image: IMPLEMENTED in the stratified sample measurement -- and the result is a MAJOR correction to the prior working assumption: activityTextEmbeddedImageFlag=true in 89.7% of n=126 sampled postings, while hasPosterFile (files[].type='포스터') matched 0/126. An OCR router keyed only on the poster-file signal would miss essentially the entire image-bearing corpus. See AGENT1_TO_AGENT3_ISSUES A1-A3-009 (now elevated to P0).

eligibilityRatesThisRelease.note: n=126 is a year-stratified (18/year x 7 years, 2020-2026) but NOT fully cross-stratified sample (jobTypes/textLen/domain strata are reported post-hoc, not pre-designed). Treat as a strong pilot signal, not the final formal sample.
